state.seed_assertion: A DPIA process should include seven key steps: identifying the need, describing the processing, considering consultation, assessing necessity and proportionality, identifying and assessing risks, identifying mitigating measures, and signing off and recording outcomes.

sentences.1: A DPIA process should include seven key steps: identifying the need, describing the processing, considering consultation, assessing necessity and proportionality, identifying and assessing risks, identifying mitigating measures, and signing off and recording outcomes.
sentences.2: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before you start your processing, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.3: It should include these steps: Step 1: identify the need for a DPIA Step 2: describe the processing Step 3: consider consultation Step 4: assess necessity and proportionality Step 5: identify and assess risks Step 6: identify measures to mitigate the risks Step 7: sign off and record outcomes
sentences.4: A DPIA must contain an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes.
sentences.5: an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes
sentences.6: A data protection impact assessment must include an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes.
sentences.7: (b)an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes
sentences.8: A DPIA must assess the necessity and proportionality of processing, including measures to ensure compliance and respect for GDPR principles.
